source.name: MLB.com press release: Pittsburgh Pirates and Sheetz announce jersey patch partnership (archived)
source.note: Club press release, read via the Wayback Machine capture of 2024-07-12 because the live mlb.com page blocks scripts. The page is dated June 21st, 2024.
source.quote: The Pittsburgh Pirates and Sheetz today announced a multi-year partnership in which the ultimate one-stop shop convenience chain will serve as the club’s first jersey patch partner.

note: Jersey patch on the sleeves of the home and away jerseys; the club's first jersey patch partner.
